text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука makes her race debut
without any
trouble.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Are you happy with your performance?

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Not really.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I know there are more difficult races to
come.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to them.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Together...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: No, you're right. We're in this together.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But, well... I guess it does feel a little
strange...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I certainly hope so.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
We'll be running in many races together,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yes... I'll be counting on you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut! You
were super
cool out there!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe... I don't know if I'd say super.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh, hello! You're Suzuka's trainer, right?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm Suzuka's roomie, Спешл Уик! I've
heard all
about you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
She says you're super nice and let her do
things
her own way!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-I didn't say it like that!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Sorry! That's pretty much the gist
though, right?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: That might be the case, but still!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And so my journey with Сайленс Судзука,
who loves
running more than anyone
else, begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure she's able to run in
all the
races she needs in order to
achieve her goal!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
